sites.name: Xuong Giang Victory Relic Site
sites.event: Commemorating the Chi Lang - Xuong Giang victory (1427) of the Lam Son army, ending 20 years of Ming dynasty rule.

sites.name: Vinh Nghiem Pagoda (La Pagoda)
sites.event: The ancestral birthplace of the Truc Lam Yen Tu Zen Sect, preserving a collection of Buddhist woodblocks recognized by UNESCO as a World Documentary Heritage.

sites.name: Bo Da Pagoda (Bo Pagoda)
sites.event: Famous for the largest stupa garden in Vietnam, unique rammed-earth wall architecture, and a collection of Buddhist woodblocks carved on thi wood.

sites.name: Yen The Uprising Relic Site
sites.event: Associated with the name of the peasant hero Hoang Hoa Tham (De Tham) and the 30-year peasant uprising (1884-1913).

sites.name: Thousand-year-old Da Huong Tree
sites.event: A rare ancient tree, bestowed the title 'Quoc chua do moc' by King Le Canh Hung, estimated to be over 1,000 years old.

sites.name: Suoi Mo Eco-tourism Area
sites.event: Associated with the legend of Princess Que Mi Nuong (Thuong Ngan Thanh Mau) opening the stream and clearing the land, featuring a system of beautiful temples and waterfalls.

sites.name: Dong Cao Plateau
sites.event: Likened to 'Mau Son' or 'Sapa' of Bac Giang with lush green grass, ancient rock fields, and a cool climate, making it a popular camping spot.

sites.name: Cam Son Lake
sites.event: A vast artificial lake with picturesque mountain and water landscapes, serving as the inspiration for the famous song 'Ho tren nui'.

place.commune: Son Hai Commune, Ho Dap Commune, Tan Son Commune, Cam Son Commune

sites.name: Dinh Huong Mausoleum
sites.event: A unique stone sculpture architectural complex from the Later Le dynasty, the resting place of Duke La Quy Hau.

sites.name: Tay Yen Tu Spiritual - Eco-tourism Area
sites.event: Recreating the path of propagating Buddhism of King-Monk Tran Nhan Tong, connecting with the Yen Tu relic site (Quang Ninh).

sites.name: Khe Ro Primeval Forest
sites.event: A typical primeval forest of Northeast Vietnam with rich flora and fauna.
